message: Verdant 15.4.3 fixes missing Tools menus caused by old extracted Verdant scripts colliding with the VCC package.
notes: VPM runtime/editor classes now use unique package-specific names.
Old Assets/VerdantBoard scripts can remain without duplicating the same package class names.
Adds Tools > Verdant Board > Diagnostics > Show VPM Status so package load can be confirmed immediately.
Includes the supporter scroll, shared clock and Main Board version-label installer.
